title: Linking timing to nitrogen use efficiency: Rice OsEC-Ghd7-ARE1 module works on it
content: High-yielding cereal varieties, for example, semi-dwarf rice and wheat, developed during the Green Revolution in the 1960s transformed global agriculture and reduced poverty (Liu et al. 2022). However, the high requirements of these cereal varieties for essential nutrient nitrogen (N) increased its fertilizer inputs over 10 times since then. Current high consumption of N fertilizers exceeds 110 million tons per year worldwide (Hu et al. 2023) and, undesirably, also contributes to global environmental changes with serious threats because of excess N pollution.
